$comment: The kernel recipe: every artifact a complete kernel needs in omx-contract, each with the wizard step that writes it, its commit layer, how it is made, its paths and its CHECKER: the name of one function in tools/kernel-recipe.mjs and its arguments, reading the real files. Plus the LAWS every kernel keeps. Read by tools/omx-new-kernel.mjs (the importer, the questions it validates, the files it writes, the commit plan) and by tools/kernel-recipe.mjs (`make completeness`: every kernel, the ones already released included, has every artifact and keeps every law). Adding a required artifact is one entry here: the wizard then writes it and the completeness check requires it of every kernel.

engine.sources: the TypeScript module or C header where the engine declares the value today: packages/core/src/*.ts, packages/declarations/src/*.ts (an export), packages/pipewire-native/src/mix_*.h (a #define of a plain number)

kernel.title: Kernel
kernel.description: The kernel's name: its file data/kernels/<kernel>.json, the name a stage's `kernel` and a plugin's `kernels` reference. Unique among the kernels.

since.title: Since
since.description: The omx-contract release that first carries the kernel.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Where the values were read: the engine repository and the commit (40 hex digits) every item's source is read at.

items.title: Items
items.description: One entry per item, in the kernel file's order: its name, its source (path and export, or path and C define), the value the importer read there, its doc, its unit when it is not a travel, and, when the engine derives it, the derivation. Written by the importer, never typed.

steps.import: the answers: every item read from the engine source where it is declared today, with its citation (omx-new-kernel.mjs --import)
steps.declare: the kernel file, written from the answers (omx-new-kernel.mjs --answers)
steps.render: the committed renders, written by omx-contract render from the data

layers.what: the engine's values for the kernel, read by the importer with each source cited
layers.message: recipes: the {kernel} kernel's answers, imported from {repo} {commit12}

layers.what: the declaration: the kernel's file, and the file an item moves out of
every file rendered from the data
layers.message: render: the {kernel} kernel in the c, json and ts renders

artifacts.what: the kernel's answers: every item with its engine source cited and the value read there, by the importer
the kernel's ONE data file: valid against the schema and the semantic checks, in the one formatting
every item of the kernel file is cited in the answers, and its resolved value is the value read from the engine source; every answered item is in the kernel file
the kernel's items survive the round trip: the json render read back gives every item's resolved value, and the kernel file re-formatted is itself
the committed c, json and ts renders are the render of the data, and the json render carries every item of the kernel
the kernel named in CHANGELOG.md, under Unreleased or the section of the release that first carries it (the first release's entry covers every kernel it shipped)

template.line: - The {kernel} kernel: {count} values, read from the engine where it declares them.

laws.what: a kernel's file holds its own items: no name also declared in another data file, and no plugin item
